findings.text: test_two_spellings_of_one_machine_render_the_same_cards guards only the launch half of the keying repair. It asserts pool.launches('98dci4-gpu-0003.iter.org') == 0, which reddens if ensure were keyed per declaration, but it never inspects a tick taken before any sample has arrived, which is the only state reaching view.py:665 pool.state(machine). Reverting that line to the declaration's own spelling, the defect the previous review reported, renders the second declaration as 'no job to sample' and leaves all 65 tests green.

The one-shot path's new reason, reason=_last_line(err) or NO_SAMPLES_REASON, has no test. The fake srun mode that writes a stderr line and streams nothing ('noisy-empty', tests/test_gpu_watch.py:350) is used only by the live test at line 562, and the one-shot no-sample test at line 458 drives mode='empty', which writes no stderr. Replacing line 296 with reason=NO_SAMPLES_REASON leaves the suite green, so the one-shot half of the stderr-reason change is unguarded.

_live_groups re-implements the local/remote partition that sample_readings performs thirteen lines above (view.py:589-593), and _live_tick re-derives _machine(entry) a third time at view.py:661. The same commit edited the sample_readings loop without pointing it at the helper, so the split into local and per-machine groups now exists in three places that must stay in step.

The reviewed run again records no baseline_suite or after_suite, and its only base-labelled gate log names dedeb919 while reporting the a3807637 test count, so it is not a pre-change arm. The head logs are sound (gate.log 65 passed EXIT=0, ruff EXIT=0, negative-control EXIT=1 on a named failing id) but added_failure_count rests on the after arm alone. This is the same evidence defect the previous review recorded at this line, unfixed.
